Mia: Quick status: dense-packer canary finished. Short summary: throughput +18% for short/medium seqs, p99 down ~35ms, est cost/token -12% after steady-state batching.

Jorge: Nice. Any problems?

Mia: Two small issues: a transient mem churn during warmup on r5-like pods (~45s) and unrelated webhook timeouts from monitoring sidecar. No correctness diffs on evals.

Ryan: SRE checked: oom_kill=0, node CPU steal unchanged. I pushed a transient GC throttle to smooth allocation.

Anika: Long-seq regression running now.

Mia: Config diff (high level): packer: dynamic -> dense, max_batch_tokens 2048 -> 3072, enable micro_batch_threading + token_window_prefetch.

DeployBot: deploy dense-packer/v1 triggered by @Mia. Rollout id rb-1956-dense. Canary targets: g4-prod-*, g5-prod-*, dedicated-small.

Priya: Rollout plan?

Mia: 02:00 UTC widen 15%->50%, 2h hold, then finish to rest by 08:00 UTC if green. Blockers: SRE mem mitigation + long-seq p99 check.

Anika: Long-seq p99 unchanged, p50 slightly better. Joining rollout.

Sam: Can you draft a 2-line blurb for product sync once fully rolled out?

Mia: Will post summary + dashboard link after full completion. :tada:
__note: Slack thread JSON. Messages concatenated in a single string; metadata fields per agents.md.
